title: PluginManifest
description: Schema every plugin's manifest.json must conform to. See docs/10-plugin-system.md#manifest.

id.description: Reverse-DNS unique identifier, immutable across versions, e.g. com.hermeszonetorba.plugins.discord.

hztApiVersion.description: SemVer range this plugin declares compatibility with, e.g. '^1.0.0'.

runtime.description: Native/unsandboxed runtimes are not supported for third-party plugins — see docs/adr/0005-plugin-sandbox-model.md.

required.description: Capability strings that must be granted for install to complete, e.g. 'notifications.send', 'network.egress:discord.com'.

optional.description: Additional capabilities the plugin can request later; default to denied.

configSchema.description: Path to a JSON Schema file describing this plugin's user-configurable settings.

signature.description: Base64 detached signature over the packaged artifact — see docs/10-plugin-system.md#trust-model.
